description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to amend the Cess on Tea, that published in the Gaz. Ex. No. 1941/32 of 20.11.2015, w.e.f. 25.07.2018
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the rate of Cess under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979. It contains a statutory instrument (Order under Section 14) that modifies existing regulations regarding tea export taxes. While it mentions a minister's name and title, this is incidental to the regulatory function being performed, and the core content focuses on legal amendments and regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
